description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2012 World Championships, built for speed and staying power. Mewtwo-EX and Raikou-EX do most of the attacking, while Eelektrik keeps Energy coming for big attacks and makes Max Potion's cost no worry. The 2012 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa, Hawaii, from 10 to 12 August 2012.

Pokémon sold it as a 2012 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
